[[Cuthbert the Chaste]] is a [[White Mantle]] [[boss]] that is part of the expedition seeking to gain access to the [[Henge of Denravi]] ahead of the [[Shining Blade]].

==Missions==
*[[Maguuma Jungle]]
**{{NPC location|Aurora Glade}}

*{{skill icon|Dryder's Defenses}}

*{{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

==Items dropped==
*[[Seeker's Vest]]
*[[White Mantle Badge]]
*[[White Mantle Emblem]]

==Notes==
*Cuthbert may randomly spawn in one of the points marked on the map. He shares them with [[Holt the Iron Boot Heel]], [[Garr the Merciful]], [[Kenric the Believer]], [[Lars the Obeisant]], and [[Manton the Indulgent]]. As such, there is a chance that Cuthbert will not spawn at all.

==Trivia==
*There is a White Mantle Mesmer boss named [[Inner Council Member Cuthbert]].
